purpose: Resolve the Base64-specific Stage-A signal with matched benign controls, raw/decoded/raw+decoded comparisons, and same-intent O1/O2/O3 transforms.

transformation_semantics.direct_decoded: plain direct text; for the Base64 mechanism comparison this is the decoded semantic request
transformation_semantics.O3_raw_plus_decoded: the same Base64 wrapper followed by the decoded direct text

primary_questions: Does Llama Guard block benign O3/Base64 controls, and if so does it emit S8?
For harmful cases, do decisions on O3_raw move toward direct_decoded when decoded text is explicitly supplied as O3_raw_plus_decoded?
Do O1, O2 and O3 produce different decisions when applied to the same harmful intents?
Is the apparent four-guard diversity under Base64 useful semantic complementarity or representation-triggered overblocking?
analysis_plan.terminology: Use native-policy intercept/non-intercept across heterogeneous guard taxonomies; use false-positive/false-negative terminology only within supported, explicitly labeled policy scope.
